{{Top|leg}}
'''Master of the Golden Yoke''' was one of the many honorific titles given to the [[perator]] of [[Cartann]], [[Pekaelic ke Teldan]]. The title referred to the customized [[Tarrvin-on-Kallik]] [[Blade-28 fighter]] [[Golden Yoke]], the personal fighter of the perator.<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>

==Appearances==
*''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]'' {{1st}}
